name: mimu-geonode-myanmar-district-boundaries-mimu
notes:
Polygons of Myanmar District boundaries (Admin2), based on the latest MIMU Pcode version 9.4 . Place names from General Administration Department (GAD), are available in Myanmar Unicode. Transliteration in roman script by MIMU.

This dataset was mainly digitized at 1:250,000 scale. Place names are in line with the general cartographic practice to reflect the names of such places as designated by the host governments.
